name: Stash v0.9.115 — Tidal joins Stash
body:
Tidal joins Stash. When Qobuz doesn't have a song in lossless, Stash now tries Tidal next — for streaming and for downloads — so far fewer songs fall back to YouTube quality.

##  What's new

- **Tidal as a second lossless source.** Songs Qobuz can't find now stream and download in FLAC from Tidal, up to 24-bit Hi-Res.
- **Tidal's high-quality AAC when there's no FLAC.** For songs that only exist on Tidal in CD quality, Stash plays and downloads Tidal's 320 kbps AAC instead of dropping to YouTube. Prefer FLAC only? Turn off **Settings → Audio & Quality → Tidal AAC when no FLAC**.
- **Online songs in your Library.** In Stream only mode, **Library → Songs** now also lists songs from your playlists that aren't downloaded, each marked, with a Downloaded / Online filter.
- **Word-synced lyrics for one song.** In Now Playing, the lyrics menu has **Get word-synced lyrics** to upgrade just the song you're listening to.
- **Display size.** **Settings → Appearance → Display size** makes the whole app bigger or smaller, including dialogs, sheets and menus.

##  Polish

- **Faster syncs.** Spotify playlists that haven't changed are no longer re-read on every sync.
- **No more duplicate copies.** Downloading a song from Search that you already have now says "Already in your library" instead of saving a second copy.
- **Shuffle behaves.** The shuffled order stays the same when a song ends, Back goes to the song you just heard, and Play next shows up in the right place.
- **Cleaner tabs.** Library and Settings drop the big title at the top; the tab bar already says where you are.

##  Good to know

- **Just update.** This version upgrades your library, so going back to an older version would mean reinstalling.
- Tidal is tried only after Qobuz, so most songs still come from Qobuz exactly as before.

---

## Install

Download `Stash.apk` below and open it on your Android device. If you've got a previous Stash release installed, this upgrades in place — your library, sync history, and settings are preserved.

**Requires:** Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.

See the [README](https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash#installation) for first-time setup.


## What's Changed
* One 'same song' rule, a faster library index, and safer blocking by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/590
* Open the web player to everyone for 48 hours by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/594
* Skip re-reading Spotify playlists that haven't changed by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/593
* Fix shuffle queue: stable order across auto-next, real back history, Play next by @ParaliyzedEvo in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/588
* Add a UI scale slider to Appearance settings by @ParaliyzedEvo in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/589
* Drop the Library and Settings titles at the top of their tabs by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/597
* Add "Get word-synced lyrics" to the Now Playing lyrics menu by @ParaliyzedEvo in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/596
* Tidal lossless: streaming + downloads via relay Worker by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/599
* Show online tracks in Library Songs with Offline/Online tags and a Downloaded/Online filter by @ParaliyzedEvo in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/595
* Site: say $1 or more on Ko-fi gets you early access by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/600
* Admin: remove everyone kept from the open window, any time later by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/601


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/compare/v0.9.114...v0.9.115
